title: Ferric Manipulations
subtitle: Ferric — blood remembers iron
text: Ferric tendency is borne by practitioners who have worked extensively with metal — smiths, miners, soldiers. Sanguine Mending (QUICK, 150): push blood into damaged tools and armor, repairing them. Sanguine Excavation (QUICK, 400): extend the iron in your blood outward through stone, breaking ore and rock in a radius. Ferric Transmutation (QUICK, 1000): transmute metal through the medium of blood. Conjure Blade / Blood Absorption / Blood Projection (QUICK, 1000 each): manifest living iron tools directly into hand from the reserve.
